violations.description: General equipment and utensils - Materials and design. — --Material of food contact surface was not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent and cleanable. Cutting boards on prep tables/coolers have deep grooves which makes it hard to get cleanable. Replace or resurface.
Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities Floors under prep coolers were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean.

General equipment and utensils - Materials and design. — --Material of food contact surface was not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent and cleanable. -Back prep table needs to be restained.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned adequately. -Condenser in freezer has ice build up.
Mechanical cleaning and sanitizing requirements. — --Sanitize solution for mechanical warewashing machine was not maintained at the proper concentration. -Was not emitting sanitizer.
